        ### >>> Self_EvolveRec-BLOCK-START: Causal exponentially weighted pooling of unscaled embeddings
        states = self.last_layernorm(seq_emb)
        if self.fusion_mode == "baseline":
            return states
        valid = (~timeline_mask).unsqueeze(-1)
        raw = self.item_emb(seq) * valid
        if self.fusion_mode == "last_fixed":
            pooled = raw
        else:
            pooled_sum = torch.zeros_like(raw)
            pooled_weight = raw.new_zeros(B, M, 1)
            # Offset zero includes the current input. Positive offsets use only
            # earlier inputs, without wraparound or any future information.
            for offset in range(min(self.recent_window, M)):
                weight = math.exp(-offset / self.recent_tau)
                if offset == 0:
                    shifted = raw
                    shifted_valid = valid.to(raw.dtype)
                else:
                    shifted = torch.cat(
                        (raw.new_zeros(B, offset, self.hidden_units), raw[:, :-offset]),
                        dim=1,
                    )
                    shifted_valid = torch.cat(
                        (raw.new_zeros(B, offset, 1), valid[:, :-offset].to(raw.dtype)),
                        dim=1,
                    )
                pooled_sum = pooled_sum + weight * shifted
                pooled_weight = pooled_weight + weight * shifted_valid
            pooled = pooled_sum / pooled_weight.clamp_min(torch.finfo(raw.dtype).eps)
        gate = (
            torch.sigmoid(self.gate_logit)
            if self.fusion_mode == "recent_learned"
            else self.fixed_gate
        )
        fused = (
            (1.0 - gate) * self.fusion_sequence_norm(states)
            + gate * self.fusion_pool_norm(pooled)
        )
        return fused * valid
